Subject: Follow-up: Security & privacy questions from Acme Health discovery call

Hey Sarah — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- High level ask: Acme Health wants to validate Redwood for a pilot (PHI-handling scope + production telemetry) and confirm SOC/GDPR/HIPAA posture and ability to sign a BAA.
- Action items we agreed on:
  1) I share SOC 2 summary and start the vendor security questionnaire (attached).
  2) Redwood security will answer detailed telemetry and cookie questions (Neha).
  3) If acceptable, procurement will follow up for BAA/contract items.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary) and vendor-security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx (stub) attached for your team to start. The SOC 2 summary highlights scope (control environment, data protection, logging, change management) and notes that the full Type II report is available under NDA — happy to coordinate that with your team.

A couple of quick clarifications based on questions we saw on the call:
- Telemetry: the Redwood Console collects anonymized usage telemetry (feature usage, API error rates, latency histograms) and optional ingestion-level logs tied to customer projects when enabled.
- Docs site: we use cookies for analytics and session management only; no PHI is present on the public docs site.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workflows and can sign a BAA for accounts that require PHI controls. Procurement usually routes to our legal team; happy to facilitate.

Next step: propose a 30-minute follow-up with Neha (+ Vivek for procurement/contract input) tomorrow or Wednesday to walk through the vendor questionnaire and a couple of telemetry examples where we can toggle collection. Is 10:00–11:30 PT tomorrow possible on your side?

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few follow-ups from our security/procurement side: 

1) SOC 2: the summary looks useful — procurement will need a formal SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Can you confirm if Redwood completed Type II and the report date?

2) HIPAA/BAA: We need confirmation that Redwood is willing to sign a BAA and a short list of controls that map to ePHI handling (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, audit logging, data retention/deletion).

3) Telemetry & Cookies: Can you confirm what exact data points are in the Console telemetry (event names, any payload fields), whether any telemetry could contain customer identifiers or email addresses, and whether telemetry collection can be disabled at the project/account level? Also, does the docs site set any third-party cookies?

4) Questionnaire: I've uploaded the vendor questionnaire to procurement and attached it here for your team to fill out. Procurement will also run a quick legal review once we have the BAA confirmation.

We can do a 30-minute session tomorrow — 10:30 PT works for me.

Hi Sarah — thanks, and great questions. Quick answers and next steps below (I'll hand off the detailed questionnaire and telemetry sample to Neha to fill out):

SOC 2 / Reports
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Nov 2025. The attached PDF is a one-page summary; the full Type II report is available under NDA — we can share via secured link or a redacted PDF once an NDA is in place.

HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood will sign a BAA for accounts that require PHI handling. Our baseline controls include: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, role-based access control (RBAC) with SSO support, detailed audit logging with retention options, and documented incident response. I will loop in legal via procurement if you need a template.

Telemetry & Cookies
- Console telemetry: primarily captures event names (api.request, console.login, model.invoke), aggregated metrics (latency, token counts), and non-identifying error traces.
- Identifiers: by default we do not collect raw email addresses or PHI in telemetry. When customers enable ingestion-level debug logs (optional), those logs may contain identifiers from your payloads — those are off by default and must be explicitly enabled per project/account.
- Toggle: telemetry collection at the project/account level can be disabled; we can provide a sample toggle and config snippet during the follow-up.
- Docs site cookies: public docs use first-party cookies for session management and analytics (Google Analytics / GA4). No PHI is present on the public docs site.

Next steps
- Neha will take the lead on completing the vendor security questionnaire and provide telemetry examples and config toggles.
- I'll coordinate SOC 2 report access under NDA if procurement requests it.
- Confirmed: 10:30 PT tomorrow for a 30-minute session — I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (questionnaire walk-through, telemetry toggle demo, BAA discussion).

Neha / Vivek / Steph — can you own the questionnaire and SOC 2 / BAA items?

Thanks — Marissa
